description: Federal Offshore Oil and Gas Tenures is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by BC Geological Survey. Federal Offshore Oil and Gas Tenures, obtained from NRCan in 2003. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher BC Geological Survey. Its tags are BC Energy Regulator, BCER, Canadian petroleum tenure, Energy Regulator, OGC. It offers 3 resource(s) in KML, ORACLE_SDE, WMS. The portal shows 2025-03-06 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Access Only. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
